name: haven-monorepo
description: An independent community chat and screen sharing application

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,web "npm run dev --workspace=@haven/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=@haven/web"
scripts.dev:hosted: node scripts/hosted-target-guard.mjs -- concurrently -k -n backend,web "npm run dev:hosted --workspace=@haven/backend" "npm run dev:hosted --workspace=@haven/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@haven/shared && npm run build --workspace=@haven/backend && npm run build --workspace=@haven/web
scripts.build:backend: npm run build --workspace=@haven/shared && npm run build --workspace=@haven/backend
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@haven/shared && npm run build --workspace=@haven/web
scripts.build:test:web: npm run build --workspace=@haven/shared && npm run build --workspace=@haven/web -- --mode test
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron apps/desktop --dev"
scripts.desktop:hosted: node scripts/hosted-target-guard.mjs -- concurrently -k "npm run dev:hosted" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron apps/desktop --dev --profile=.hosted-profile"
scripts.package:win: npm run package:win:portable && npm run package:installer
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:web && npm run test:desktop
scripts.check: npm run build --workspace=@haven/shared && npm run check --workspace=@haven/backend && npm run check --workspace=@haven/web
